# pi-listen

> Voice input and side-channel conversations for the Pi coding agent CLI.

## Overview

pi-listen is a Pi extension that adds hands-free voice-to-text input and BTW (by-the-way) side conversations to the Pi coding agent. It supports 5 STT backends (faster-whisper, moonshine, whisper-cpp, Deepgram, Parakeet) with a persistent daemon for zero cold-start transcription.

## Key Components

- `extensions/voice.ts`: Main extension — recording, daemon IPC, BTW, UI
- `extensions/voice/config.ts`: Configuration loading, saving, migration
- `extensions/voice/diagnostics.ts`: Environment scanning, backend detection
- `extensions/voice/onboarding.ts`: Interactive first-run setup wizard
- `extensions/voice/install.ts`: Provisioning plan builder
- `daemon.py`: Persistent STT daemon with warm model cache
- `transcribe.py`: Multi-backend transcription engine

## Features

- Hold-to-talk voice input (spacebar or Ctrl+Shift+V)
- Persistent STT daemon for zero cold-start latency
- 5 STT backends: faster-whisper, moonshine, whisper-cpp, Deepgram (cloud), Parakeet
- BTW side conversations for parallel questions
- Guided first-run onboarding
- Global and project-scoped configuration
- macOS and Windows bootstrap scripts
- VAD (Voice Activity Detection) pre-filtering

## API

### Commands
- `/voice [on|off|test|info|setup|reconfigure|doctor|backends|daemon]`
- `/btw <message>` — Side conversation
- `/btw:new`, `/btw:clear`, `/btw:inject`, `/btw:summarize`

### Keybindings
- `SPACE` (hold, empty editor) — Record to editor
- `Ctrl+Shift+V` — Toggle recording
- `Ctrl+Shift+B` (hold) — Record to BTW

### Configuration
Settings in `~/.pi/agent/settings.json` or `<project>/.pi/settings.json` under the `voice` key.

## Installation

```
pi install npm:@codexstar/pi-listen
```
